note: Pins by number for the SOT-23-5 (DBV) variant; what each function means and its default net class. The DBV variant has no power-good pin: PG exists only on TLV62569PDDC and TLV62569PDRL (Device Comparison, p.1; Pin Functions, p.3).

power.note: Recommended operating range. The converter's own draw is its quiescent current, on VOUT's iq_a; the supply rule adds the load's input current

VIN.note: Power supply input, 2.5-5.5 V recommended (p.4), 6 V absolute maximum (p.3). Also the high-side switch's drain: CIN goes between this pin and GND.

GND.note: Ground pin: the low-side switch's return and the control ground (one pin, no exposed pad on DBV).

SW.note: Switch node: the internal FETs to the inductor. DC -0.3 V to VIN+0.3 V; -3 V to 9 V for under 10 ns while switching (p.3).

FB.note: Feedback input, regulated to VFB = 0.6 V (0.588-0.612 V). Connect to an external divider from VOUT; 5.5 V absolute maximum.

EN.note: Enable, active high: VIH 1.2 V max, VIL 0.4 V min (2.5 V <= VIN <= 5.5 V). Must not be left floating. Low = shutdown, 0.1 uA typical, 2 uA max.

levels.note: VIH 1.2 V max and VIL 0.4 V min for 2.5 V <= VIN <= 5.5 V; EN's absolute maximum is 6 V, whatever VIN is

VOUT.note: Not a pin: the package circuit's output, past L1 and the RFB_TOP/RFB_BOT divider (circuit port VOUT). Described here so the supply rule can match it

enable.note: The package circuit's R_EN (1 MOhm to VIN) holds EN high; the chip's own EN must not float (§7.4.1 p.7)

power.note: v_out: VFB 0.588-0.612 V (p.4) times 1 + 453k/100k with both resistors at 1 % worst case (3.318 V nominal). In Power Save Mode the output rises slightly above nominal (§7.3.1 p.6, not quantified). i_max_a is the recommended maximum output current (§6.3 p.4); this circuit's caps and L1 (3.4 A) were picked for it. Below regulation it runs at 100 % duty, VIN(min) = VOUT + IOUT x (RDS(on) + RL) (§7.3.2 p.6): r_on_ohm is the high-side RDS(on), 100 mOhm typical at VIN = 5 V with no maximum given (p.5), plus L1's 52 mOhm maximum DCR (smnr4020_ds p.4). iq_a typical, not switching (p.4). theta_ja for DBV (SOT-23-5) on the JEDEC board (§6.4 p.4); tj_max the operating maximum (§6.3 p.4)
